name: Sea Reserve
description: 600-point reserve that fuels Echolocation and Pod Call. Out of water: lose 1 per second (empty in about 10 minutes). Standing in any water or rain refills it at 20 per second (empty to full in 30 seconds). A placed water bucket works. At 300 or less, hunger drains x1.20 faster. At 150 or less, natural healing is halved. At 0 while dry, movement speed x0.90.
